output.reason: The changelog [ev-d83aa8e2cc23] and the PR title and description [ev-4120f7386ac5][ev-a09101c7e15d] say only that logs RBAC is now enforced by default. They do not name the controlling setting or say which policies lose log access. The proposed runtime-behavior-gap leaf is not justified, because the changed files [ev-88b2096256eb] include docs/operator-manual/argocd-cm.yaml, util/settings/settings.go and the 2.14-3.0 upgrade guide. That points to a configuration key and RBAC policy (configuration, not runtime state) that a predicate could read. To write the exposure condition we need the upgrade-guide or argocd-cm.yaml text that names the key, its old and new default, and which roles or policies lack a logs grant.
